{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Indonesia|Cuisine of Indonesia]]

'''Saus kacang''' is a spicy Indonesian peanut sauce.

==Ingredients==
* 2 cans of natural [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Water|Water]]
* Sambal oelek
* 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|Soy sauce]]

==Procedure==
# Mix the peanut butter with water, and stir gently until smooth.
# Add some sambal oelek, some lemon juice, salt, and soy sauce. Keep stirring, adjusting the ingredients to get the taste right.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If using stabilized peanut butter, mix in a small amount of [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut]] or [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]].
